description: This file implements a class for securely storing, retrieving, and managing OAuth tokens and related metadata within a Visual Studio Code extension environment. It includes interfaces for token data, methods for token storage, retrieval, deletion, and server list management.

classes.name: McpOAuthTokenStorage
classes.description: A class for managing OAuth token storage and retrieval using VS Code's SecretStorage and global state.

methods.name: storeTokens
methods.description: Stores OAuth tokens and optional refresh metadata securely and updates server list.

methods.name: getTokens
methods.description: Retrieves stored OAuth tokens without refresh metadata.

methods.name: getFullTokenData
methods.description: Retrieves full stored token data including refresh metadata.

methods.name: removeTokens
methods.description: Removes stored tokens for a given server URL.

methods.name: listServers
methods.description: Lists all server URLs with stored tokens.

methods.name: addServerToList
methods.description: Adds a server URL to the list of servers with stored tokens.

methods.name: removeServerFromList
methods.description: Removes a server URL from the list of servers with stored tokens.
